Check out Greptile, the best AI code reviewer I've ever used: https://jetty.to/greptile

So Claude Code's source code has been leaked. A person by the name of Chaofan Shou found that Claude Code's npm package included a source map file. Which is a JSON file that, well, quite literally contains all of the original source code embedded inside it.
